note: Commerce Ajax ATC makes the Commerce add-to-cart form submit over AJAX with a configurable confirmation. Two pieces of state: (1) per-display enablement via the enable_ajax third-party setting (namespace commerce_ajax_atc) on the commerce_add_to_cart formatter, stored on the 'variations' component of core.entity_view_display.commerce_product.<bundle>.<mode>; (2) the global config object commerce_ajax_atc.settings, central key pop_up_type in {non_modal, modal_dialog, colorbox}, plus button/message/modal/colorbox keys. The module ships NO config/install for commerce_ajax_atc.settings, so it does not exist until saved (baseline restore = delete it). Settings form route commerce_ajax_atc.ajax_settings_form at /admin/commerce/config/ajax-settings (permission 'access ajax atc administration pages'). It also swaps commerce_cart.cart_subscriber for AjaxCartEventSubscriber and installs the commerce_ajax_atc_popup variation view mode. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real config object and the real default commerce_product display (Commerce + commerce_product installed; product type 'default' display has a commerce_add_to_cart 'variations' component). All scripts were smoke-tested.

evals.prompt: How do I turn on AJAX add-to-cart for a product in the commerce_ajax_atc module — is there a global switch, or is it per display? What is the setting called and where is it stored?
evals.expected_output: It is enabled per product display: on Manage display, the commerce_add_to_cart formatter (the Variations field) gains an 'Enable Ajax' checkbox. It is stored as the enable_ajax third-party setting (namespace commerce_ajax_atc) on the 'variations' component of that entity_view_display, e.g. core.entity_view_display.commerce_product.default.default.

evals.prompt: In commerce_ajax_atc, which config object holds the global pop-up settings and what are the possible confirmation (pop-up) types?
evals.expected_output: Global settings live in commerce_ajax_atc.settings. The confirmation style is the pop_up_type key with values non_modal (a non-modal inline message), modal_dialog (a core modal dialog), or colorbox (requires Colorbox Load).

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the commerce_ajax_atc add-to-cart pop-up (which admin path), and what permission is required?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is the route commerce_ajax_atc.ajax_settings_form at /admin/commerce/config/ajax-settings (under Commerce > Configuration > Ajax), gated by the 'access ajax atc administration pages' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, how is the commerce_ajax_atc add-to-cart confirmation configured to appear (non-modal message, modal dialog, or colorbox)? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: commerce_ajax_atc.settings has pop_up_type = modal_dialog (a modal dialog pop-up; its ajax_modal_title is 'CAATC probe modal'). Read it with `drush cget commerce_ajax_atc.settings pop_up_type`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, is AJAX add-to-cart (commerce_ajax_atc) enabled on the default product's default display? Inspect the live entity view display to answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — the 'variations' component of core.entity_view_display.commerce_product.default.default has third_party_settings.commerce_ajax_atc.enable_ajax = true, so AJAX add-to-cart is enabled for that display.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, configure commerce_ajax_atc so the add-to-cart confirmation shows as a modal dialog and includes a 'View cart' button. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In commerce_ajax_atc.settings set pop_up_type = 'modal_dialog' and include_cart_button = true (via the settings form at /admin/commerce/config/ajax-settings or drush cset).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, turn on AJAX add-to-cart (commerce_ajax_atc) for the default product type's default display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.commerce_product.default.default, set the 'variations' component's third_party_settings.commerce_ajax_atc.enable_ajax to TRUE (tick 'Enable Ajax' on the Add to cart / commerce_add_to_cart formatter in Manage display, or set it via the display API).
